sections.heading: Verka Ludhiana Dairy: Half a Century of Processing
paragraphs: Verka's own history of the Ludhiana plant records that the foundation stone was laid in 1970 and the dairy was commissioned in 1974 at 1 lakh litres a day under Operation Flood-I. It passed to Milkfed in April 1983 and to the Milk Union Ludhiana in April 1988.
In 1992, under Operation Flood-III, the plant was expanded to 4 lakh litres a day at a cost of Rs 18 crore, adding a 30 MT powder plant built around MVR evaporation technology.

sections.heading: Product Lines Listed for the Ludhiana Plant
paragraphs: Verka lists rated capacities at Ludhiana of 2,70,000 litres for city milk supply, 10 MT of dahi, 25 MT of lassi, 1,500 kg of paneer, 1,000 kg of kheer, 8 MT of ghee, 30 MT of powder, 100 kg of milk cake and 10 MT of table butter. Its product range covers ghee, table butter, skimmed and whole milk powder, paneer, milk cake, dahi, lassi and kheer.
That spread means a single site runs liquid milk, cultured products, fat products and drying side by side, and each section has a different case for the tube it uses.

sections.heading: The 2022 Processing and Butter Plant in Ludhiana
paragraphs: The Tribune reported that on 19 October 2022 Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann inaugurated a new Verka milk processing and butter plant at Ludhiana. The report put the project at Rs 105 crore, with 9 lakh litres a day of processing and 10 MT a day of butter handling, and said Verka's supply to Delhi would rise from 30,000 to 2 lakh litres.

sections.heading: Where Ludhiana Lines Need 316L SF4 and Where They Do Not
paragraphs: Butter, ghee and cultured product lines, and the evaporator and powder-plant feed, hold fat and protein against the wall, so we recommend 316L to ASTM A270 with an SF4 electropolished bore there. Each electropolished lot is supplied with an Ra report and an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to the heat number.
For bulk milk reception, chilled water and cleaning returns, SF1 or mill-finish 304L is normally adequate and costs less per metre, so a large Ludhiana order can be split between the two finishes.

Where an older Ludhiana line is being extended rather than replaced, the outside diameter and wall of the existing tube should be measured first, because clamp ferrules and butt-weld fittings are sized to them and a mismatch shows up only at installation.

sections.heading: What to Send With a Ludhiana Enquiry
bullets: Section of the plant: reception, butter, ghee, curd and lassi, powder or CIP
Outside diameter, wall thickness and metres required for each size
Grade and finish: 316L SF4, 304L SF1 or mill finish
Applicable standard: ASTM A270, A269 or ASME BPE
Any fittings, ferrules or reducers to be quoted alongside the tube
A drawing, or a photo with a tape against the pipe, where new tube must match an existing run

sections.heading: Delivery to Ludhiana and Central Punjab
paragraphs: Tube for Ludhiana is sent by road from Mumbai, with electropolished lengths capped and sleeved against damage, and the dispatch date and transit are given in writing when the order is confirmed. Every length is PMI-checked, and a complete enquiry is quoted within 24 hours.
